svg.title: How pg_pinecone works
svg.desc: An application sends a standard pgvector query to Postgres, which keeps the rows and vectors. pg_pinecone runs the search with one of three engines. The native engine, the default, runs the search engine Pinecone uses at scale inside Postgres. The pgvector engine keeps pgvector’s own HNSW or IVFFlat index. The remote engine, for tables that outgrow one Postgres server, syncs writes to a Pinecone serverless index and returns results as rows. pinecone.set_engine() switches engines, and the same SQL works with every engine.
